page.title: wh語は、穴の種類を教える

analysis.summaryJa: このページは関係語を、先行詞の種類だけでなく後続節に欠けている役割を示す標識として整理する。人ならwho、物ならwhichという基本に加え、場所名詞でも目的語の穴ならwhich、時名詞でも目的語の穴ならwhichとなるため、節が完全か不完全かを先に診断する。
grammarPoints: whoは人が主語または目的語になる穴を示す
whichは物・事柄が主語または目的語になる穴を示す
whereは場所そのものではなく「そこで・そこへ」という副詞的な穴を示す
whenは「その時に」という時の副詞的な穴を示す
whyはreasonに対応する理由の穴を示す
場所名詞の後でも節に目的語が欠ければwhichまたはthatを使う
時を表す名詞の後でも節に目的語が欠ければwhichまたはthatを使う
前置詞＋whichはwhereなどに相当する改まった形を作れる
visualEvidence: 五つの色分けされた穴が人・物・場所・時・理由のゲートへ続いている
WHO・WHICH・WHERE・WHEN・WHYのプラグが対応する役割の穴だけにはまる図になっている
場所名詞と時名詞のカードには、名詞の意味ではなく節内の欠け方を確認する注意表示がある
ミニ問題では先行詞stationでも節にvisitedの目的語が欠けるためwhichを選ぶ過程が示されている
commonTraps: 人なら必ずwho、場所なら必ずwhereと先行詞だけで決める
whichが作った目的語の穴にitを置く
reasonの後なら文脈を見ず常にwhyとする
前置詞が必要な場所関係を裸のwhichだけで表す
節が完全かどうかを動詞の目的語まで確認しない

questions.prompt: The coordinator ------- will greet the overseas guests speaks French.

choices.A: who
choices.D: when

questions.translationJa: 海外からの来賓を迎えるコーディネーターはフランス語を話します。
questions.explanationJa: will greetの主語が欠け、先行詞が人なのでwhoを使います。

questions.prompt: The sensor ------- detects smoke is mounted near the ceiling.

choices.A: who
choices.D: why

questions.translationJa: 煙を検知するセンサーは天井付近に取り付けられています。
questions.explanationJa: detectsの主語となる物sensorをwhichで受けます。

questions.prompt: The specialist ------- we contacted will arrive before noon.

choices.A: where
choices.D: which

questions.translationJa: 私たちが連絡した専門家は正午前に到着します。
questions.explanationJa: we contactedの目的語が欠け、その役割を人specialistが担うのでwhoです。

questions.prompt: The estimate ------- the contractor submitted exceeds our budget.

choices.A: where
choices.D: which

questions.translationJa: 請負業者が提出した見積書は私たちの予算を超えています。
questions.explanationJa: the contractor submittedの目的語の穴に物estimateが入るためwhichです。

questions.prompt: The branch ------- customers can test the products opens at ten.

choices.A: where
choices.D: why

questions.translationJa: 顧客が製品を試せる支店は10時に開店します。
questions.explanationJa: customers can test the productsは完全で、欠ける場所情報をwhereが示します。

questions.prompt: Tuesday is the day ------- the inspection team will visit our site.

choices.A: which
choices.D: why

questions.translationJa: 火曜日が検査チームが当社拠点を訪れる日です。
questions.explanationJa: 節に欠けている「その日に」という時の役割をwhenが示します。

questions.prompt: The memo explains the reason ------- access was temporarily restricted.

choices.A: where
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: そのメモはアクセスが一時的に制限された理由を説明しています。
questions.explanationJa: reasonに続く原因内容をwhyでつなぎます。

questions.prompt: The facility ------- our company purchased last year is being renovated.

choices.A: where
choices.D: which

questions.translationJa: 当社が昨年購入した施設は改装中です。
questions.explanationJa: 場所名詞facilityでも、our company purchasedの目的語が欠けているためwhichです。

questions.prompt: The date ------- the committee selected conflicts with another event.

choices.A: which
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 委員会が選んだ日付は別の行事と重なっています。
questions.explanationJa: the committee selectedの目的語が欠けるため、時名詞でもwhichを選びます。

questions.prompt: The platform from ------- the train departs is being repaired.

choices.A: where
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 列車が出発するホームは修理中です。
questions.explanationJa: 前置詞fromの目的語として物・場所platformを受けるためwhichを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a human subject hole.

choices.A: The nurse which manages the clinic will call you.
choices.B: The nurse who she manages the clinic will call you.
choices.C: The nurse who manages the clinic will call you.
choices.D: The nurse where manages the clinic will call you.

questions.translationJa: その診療所を管理する看護師があなたに電話します。
questions.explanationJa: 人nurseがmanagesの主語なのでwhoのみを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a thing subject hole.

choices.A: The shuttle who stops at Terminal 2 runs every 20 minutes.
choices.B: The shuttle which it stops at Terminal 2 runs every 20 minutes.
choices.C: The shuttle where stops at Terminal 2 runs every 20 minutes.
choices.D: The shuttle which stops at Terminal 2 runs every 20 minutes.

questions.translationJa: 第2ターミナルに停車するシャトルは20分間隔で運行します。
questions.explanationJa: 物shuttleがstopsの主語なのでwhichを使い、itは不要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a human object hole.

choices.A: The adviser who the director consulted recommended a delay.
choices.B: The adviser who the director consulted her recommended a delay.
choices.C: The adviser which the director consulted recommended a delay.
choices.D: The adviser who consulted the director him recommended a delay.

questions.translationJa: 取締役が相談した助言者は延期を勧めました。
questions.explanationJa: the director consultedの目的語の穴に人adviserが入るためwhoです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a thing object hole.

choices.A: The model where the team selected uses less electricity.
choices.B: The model which the team selected uses less electricity.
choices.C: The model which the team selected it uses less electricity.
choices.D: The model who the team selected uses less electricity.

questions.translationJa: チームが選んだモデルは消費電力が少ないです。
questions.explanationJa: the team selectedの目的語として物modelをwhichで受けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a place with a complete clause.

choices.A: The hall which the awards ceremony will take place seats 500 people.
choices.B: The hall where the awards ceremony will take place there seats 500 people.
choices.C: The hall where the awards ceremony will take place seats 500 people.
choices.D: The hall who the awards ceremony will take place seats 500 people.

questions.translationJa: 授賞式が行われるホールは500人収容できます。
questions.explanationJa: take placeの節は主語と動詞がそろい、場所だけが欠けるのでwhereです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a time with a complete clause.

choices.A: Spring is the season which demand for bicycles increases it.
choices.B: Spring is the season when demand for bicycles increases then.
choices.C: Spring is the season who demand for bicycles increases.
choices.D: Spring is the season when demand for bicycles increases.

questions.translationJa: 春は自転車の需要が増える季節です。
questions.explanationJa: demand increasesに時の情報を加えるためwhenを使い、thenは重ねません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a reason.

choices.A: We need to identify the reason why the payment was rejected.
choices.B: We need to identify the reason where the payment was rejected.
choices.C: We need to identify the reason why the payment was rejected for it.
choices.D: We need to identify why the reason was the payment rejected.

questions.translationJa: 支払いが拒否された理由を特定する必要があります。
questions.explanationJa: reasonに対応する理由内容をwhyで導きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence for a place noun used as an object.

choices.A: The warehouse where the retailer leased has two loading bays.
choices.B: The warehouse which the retailer leased has two loading bays.
choices.C: The warehouse which the retailer leased it has two loading bays.
choices.D: The warehouse when the retailer leased has two loading bays.

questions.translationJa: 小売業者が借りた倉庫には荷役口が2か所あります。
questions.explanationJa: the retailer leasedの目的語が欠けるので、場所名詞でもwhichです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence for a time noun used as an object.

choices.A: The week when we chose for training is already fully booked.
choices.B: The week which we chose it for training is already fully booked.
choices.C: The week which we chose for training is already fully booked.
choices.D: The week where we chose for training is already fully booked.

questions.translationJa: 研修用に選んだ週はすでに予約で埋まっています。
questions.explanationJa: we choseの目的語の穴にweekが入るためwhichを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct formal sentence with a fronted preposition.

choices.A: The conference room in that we met has new equipment.
choices.B: The conference room which in we met has new equipment.
choices.C: The conference room in which we met there has new equipment.
choices.D: The conference room in which we met has new equipment.

questions.translationJa: 私たちが会議をした部屋には新しい設備があります。
questions.explanationJa: 改まった形ではinをwhichの前へ置き、thereを重ねません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The agent who processed the refund sent an email.”

choices.A: The refund processed an email for the agent.
choices.B: The agent processed the refund and sent an email.
choices.C: An email processed the agent’s refund.
choices.D: The agent emailed someone who refunded the process.

questions.translationJa: 返金を処理した担当者がメールを送りました。
questions.explanationJa: whoはagentをprocessedの主語としてつなぎます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The machine which labels the boxes is offline.”

choices.A: The machine labels the boxes, and it is offline.
choices.B: The boxes label an offline machine.
choices.C: An offline label is inside the machine.
choices.D: The machine needs boxes which are already offline.

questions.translationJa: 箱にラベルを貼る機械は停止しています。
questions.explanationJa: which labels ...はmachineが行う動作を説明します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The architect who we hired specializes in hotels.”

choices.A: The architect hired us to build a hotel.
choices.C: The hotel specializes in hiring architects.
choices.D: We hired the architect, and the architect specializes in hotels.

questions.translationJa: 私たちが雇った建築家はホテルを専門としています。
questions.explanationJa: we hiredの目的語がarchitectで、その人の専門を主節が述べています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The vehicle which we rented has a navigation system.”

choices.A: The navigation system rented a vehicle for us.
choices.B: We rented a system that navigates vehicles.
choices.C: We rented the vehicle, and it has a navigation system.
choices.D: The vehicle rented us to install navigation.

questions.translationJa: 私たちが借りた車にはナビゲーションシステムがあります。
questions.explanationJa: whichはwe rentedの目的語としてvehicleを受けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “This is the desk where guests return their keys.”

choices.A: Guests return the desk with their keys.
choices.B: Guests return their keys at this desk.
choices.C: This desk returns keys to every guest.
choices.D: Guests ask which key built the desk.

questions.translationJa: ここが宿泊客が鍵を返すデスクです。
questions.explanationJa: whereはat this deskという場所の役割を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Noon is the time when the cafeteria becomes busiest.”

choices.A: The cafeteria becomes busiest at noon.
choices.B: The cafeteria chooses noon as an object.
choices.D: The cafeteria closes before every busy time.

questions.translationJa: 正午が食堂が最も混雑する時間です。
questions.explanationJa: whenはat noonに相当する時の役割です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We know the reason why the shipment was returned.”

choices.A: We know the place where the shipment was returned.
choices.B: The returned shipment knows our reason.
choices.C: We returned the reason with the shipment.
choices.D: We know what caused the shipment to be returned.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは貨物が返送された理由を知っています。
questions.explanationJa: why節は返送を引き起こした理由を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The site which the company bought will become a factory.”

choices.A: The company bought a factory located at every site.
choices.B: The site bought the company’s factory.
choices.C: The company bought the site, and it will become a factory.
choices.D: The company operates at the site but did not buy it.

questions.translationJa: 会社が購入した用地は工場になります。
questions.explanationJa: 場所名詞siteはboughtの目的語なのでwhichでつながっています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The day which the board selected is a public holiday.”

choices.A: The board met on a public holiday without selecting a day.
choices.B: The board selected the day, but it is a public holiday.
choices.C: The public holiday selected the board.
choices.D: The board selected what happened on that day.

questions.translationJa: 取締役会が選んだ日は祝日です。
questions.explanationJa: dayはselectedの目的語であり、時の副詞穴ではありません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The office in which the files are stored is locked.”

choices.A: The files are stored in the office, and the office is locked.
choices.B: The office is stored inside the locked files.
choices.C: The files lock the office in storage.
choices.D: The office stores a lock instead of files.

questions.translationJa: 書類が保管されている事務所は施錠されています。
questions.explanationJa: in whichはin the officeという場所関係を表します。

questions.prompt: “Which instructor is leading the seminar?” “The woman ------- is speaking with Mr. Hall.”

choices.A: which
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 「どの講師がセミナーを担当しますか」「ホールさんと話している女性です」
questions.explanationJa: is speakingの主語となる人womanをwhoで特定します。

questions.prompt: “Which alarm should we replace?” “The one ------- sounds every few minutes.”

choices.A: who
choices.D: why

questions.translationJa: 「どの警報器を交換しますか」「数分おきに鳴るものです」
questions.explanationJa: soundsの主語となる物alarmをwhichで受けます。

questions.prompt: “Do you remember the courier?” “Yes, he is the man ------- we met downstairs.”

choices.A: where
choices.D: which

questions.translationJa: 「その配達員を覚えていますか」「はい、階下で会った男性です」
questions.explanationJa: we metの目的語の穴に人manが入るためwhoです。

questions.prompt: “Which quotation is current?” “The one ------- the supplier emailed this morning.”

choices.A: which
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 「どの見積書が最新ですか」「仕入先が今朝メールしたものです」
questions.explanationJa: the supplier emailedの目的語として物quotationをwhichで受けます。

questions.prompt: “Where can I collect my visitor badge?” “At the desk ------- the security staff checks identification.”

choices.A: which
choices.D: where

questions.translationJa: 「来訪者バッジはどこで受け取れますか」「警備員が身分証を確認するデスクです」
questions.explanationJa: 節は完全で、欠ける「そのデスクで」をwhereが示します。

questions.prompt: “When will the system be unavailable?” “Sunday is the day ------- the update will be installed.”

choices.A: which
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 「システムはいつ利用できませんか」「日曜日が更新を導入する日です」
questions.explanationJa: the update will be installedに時の情報を加えるwhenが適切です。

questions.prompt: “Why did the team change hotels?” “The manager explained the reason ------- the first booking was canceled.”

choices.A: where
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 「なぜチームはホテルを変更したのですか」「マネージャーが最初の予約が取り消された理由を説明しました」
questions.explanationJa: reasonに対応する理由内容をwhyで導きます。

questions.prompt: The office ------- our company acquired is located near the airport.

choices.A: which
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 当社が取得した事務所は空港の近くにあります。
questions.explanationJa: our company acquiredの目的語が欠けるため、場所名詞でもwhichです。

questions.prompt: The month ------- the committee chose for the audit is extremely busy.

choices.A: when
choices.D: which

questions.translationJa: 委員会が監査用に選んだ月は非常に忙しい時期です。
questions.explanationJa: the committee choseの目的語がmonthなのでwhichを選びます。

questions.prompt: The cabinet in ------- the original contracts are kept is fire-resistant.

choices.A: where
choices.D: when

questions.translationJa: 原本契約書が保管されているキャビネットは耐火性です。
questions.explanationJa: 前置詞inの目的語となる物cabinetをwhichで受けます。
